name: A turn done in seconds gets its finish in silence, a failed one is said
case: The person and the agent go back and forth: the agent answers in a few seconds. Boop plays the finish, a small face held once, but says nothing, since it's just back-and-forth. Later a turn fails just as quickly, and that gets its failure as any failure does.
why: PERSONALITY: a very short turn (under 7 seconds) that ends done is back-and-forth, its finish, small, in silence; every turn that ends failed gets a face and its finish. Its Examples: a very short turn done is pleased, success, in silence, small
